args.content:
# Firmware not applicable
Programmable components: none
Reason: Separate passive CC resistors enable USB-C attachment, and the always-enabled TPS2065C analog switch feeds both parallel power outputs and the resistor-limited LED without a processor or executable software.

# Stage 7 firmware applicability

## Fresh captured-design evidence

Stage 7 native evidence, 2026-10-08: list_symbols and schematic lib_id search confirm ten fitted non-programmable parts using seven reviewed symbol types. verify_symbols reports 11 definitions matching installed libraries or exact engine power templates with no divergences; ERC and BOM/PINOUT drift are clean. Onboard firmware is NOT APPLICABLE for this captured analog design. firmware/README.md records the required three-line hardware-only explanation; no source, binary, HAL, flashing target or build is invented. Engine power/flag symbols are verified schematic metadata, not programmable parts. The original finish gate determines stage acceptance. The four intrinsic J1 DRC findings, conditional electrical budgets and all physical qualification remain unresolved; the original bring-up/development stage still applies.

Rationale: use actual current-run inventory and verification, rather than assuming non-programmability from a product name or silently skipping the firmware stage.

## Reviewed inventory

The fresh native list_symbols returns exactly C1, C2, D1, J1, J2, J3, R1, R2, R4 and U1. The schematic lib_id search and read-back schematic.intent.json agree on these seven physical symbol types, all explicitly reviewed by the original Stage 7 contract:

- Device:C: C1/C2, nonpolar 1uF bypass capacitors.
- Device:LED: D1, WP710A10LID indicator.
- Device:R: R1/R2 independent 5.1k CC terminations and R4 10k LED limiter.
- Connector:USB_C_Receptacle_USB2.0_16P: J1, USB4105-GF-A power input.
- Connector:Screw_Terminal_01x02: J2, 1984617 output terminal.
- Connector_Generic:Conn_02x02_Odd_Even: J3, M20-9980246 output header.
- Power_Management:TPS2065CDBV: U1, fitted TPS2065CDBVR analog high-side protection switch.

The remaining four verified definitions are engine-generated power/flag metadata: copperhead_power:PWR_FLAG, copperhead_power:+5V_PROTECTED, copperhead_power:GND and copperhead_power:VBUS_RAW. They are not fitted components. No unknown/custom fitted part or unreviewed IC is assumed non-programmable. No MCU, programmable logic, firmware-bearing peripheral, radio or digital interface is fitted. MCU strapping, RTC-capability and antenna checks therefore do not apply to this unchanged inventory.

Rationale: distinguish canonical physical components from exact generating-template metadata while keeping unsupported physical symbols outside the acceptance case.

## Hardware-only operation and intentional omissions

J1 supplies VBUS_RAW. Separate R1/R2 connect CC1/CC2 to GND; they support attachment without joining the CC nets, negotiating USB-PD or establishing source-current entitlement. U1 pin 5 IN and active-high pin 4 EN are tied to VBUS_RAW. U1 pin 1 OUT alone supplies +5V_PROTECTED, shared by J2, J3, C2 and the R4/LED_A/D1 indicator branch. U1 pin 2 is ground and pin 3 FLT is intentionally unconnected. Analog device behavior operates without firmware. C1 bypasses the input.

R3/ILIM_SET remain intentionally absent because the selected U1 has a fixed current limit. No unused FLT pull-up, EN bias resistor, added processor, USB data path or unplanned VBUS load is introduced. The README has exactly the required three nonblank lines. There is no applicable pins.h, driver stub, happy-path executable, programming interface, compile, flash or vendor-toolchain result. This is an applicability conclusion, not a successful firmware build or an unavailable-toolchain claim.

Rationale: a software scaffold would misrepresent this hardware and could introduce unjustified power, pin and manufacturing obligations.

## Actual native checks and evidence limits

Fresh v19 results: proposal validation passed; the nonempty ten-refdes schematic matches BOM/PINOUT with drift clean; ERC clean; verify_symbols reports 11 matching definitions and no divergences. check_legibility reports zero errors and one low-utilization advisory, with occupied fraction 0.29 versus advisory threshold 0.5. No sheet edit is needed for this accepted advisory.

Fresh native run_drc reports clean for the original placement/routing gate and separately retains four J1 hole_clearance findings inside the existing library footprint. These findings are not fixed, suppressed or waived. The historical independent Stage 5 raw KiCad check on the unchanged board reported four errors at 0.1944 mm against 0.2500 mm, exit 5, and zero unconnected items; that independent raw check was not repeated in this firmware stage. See docs/LAYOUT.md and docs/OUTPUTS.md. Native stage acceptance does not mean raw-zero DRC or manufacturer acceptance.

The inherited U1 descriptive-property limitation in BOM/PINOUT remains. Fitted U1 is TPS2065CDBVR with the verified five-pin map; embedded TPS2051C parent prose is not device-rating evidence. No hardware, BOM, KiCad project settings, intent or output-manifest source is changed in Stage 7. Existing exports remain review-only; this stage does not replace the original source-bound export checks or claim to have rerun export generation.

Rationale: record exactly the fresh checks and distinguish them from historical evidence and unperformed validation.

## Unchanged release conditions and next stage

Preserve 4.75-5.25 V, 500 mA total continuous external load on either output alone or shared, and strictly less than 2 mA unloaded VBUS over assumed 0-50 C. The 0.831 mA allocation is conditional, not a proven whole-board maximum. Preserve the below-USD-8 Q100 component target, the conditional USD 2.5439 estimate, and unresolved quotations/header availability. The required envelope remains at most 40 x 30 mm, two 1 oz copper layers and nominal 1.6 mm FR-4 with accessible manual assembly.

No physical prototype has been manufactured or tested. Exact-device fault/thermal/recovery review, source/cable capacity, current-limit spread and overshoot, whole-range leakage/bias, effective capacitance, visibility, loaded voltage drop, assembly and connector geometry remain open. Resolve all four J1 findings and J3 finished holes of 0.97-1.07 mm before fabrication. Outputs remain load-only, with no backfeed or paralleled supplies. No order, manufacturing release or energized test is authorized by this document.

The original Stage 8 bring-up/development plan must cover safe assembly/polarity checks, separate CC termination and both USB orientations, known-capable source/cable use, current/voltage measurements across operating extremes, 500 mA on each output alone and shared, LED visibility, startup/inrush, overload/sustained-short heating and recovery. Tests remain pending and must later record actual equipment, conditions and results. Keep the common protection path for both outputs and LED.

Rationale: firmware non-applicability closes only the software-applicability question; every original hardware target and qualification obligation still applies.
